_doc: Each Hunter's quiet foley layer under its steps and dashes (MoveSfx, docs/AUDIO.md). One row per archetype: note = what makes the sound (from its final design); step_db / dash_db = that Hunter's level trim in dB (its sounds are <arch>_foley and <arch>_foley_dash, made by tools/gen_sfx_foley.py). A step's foley follows the Hunter's speed: walk_db quieter at a standstill, full level at its base run speed. Foley is carried to step_reach_m like the step itself; at most voice_cap foley sounds start per voice_window_ms across all Hunters, so a crowd of 30 stays readable. base_db: the level before the role (own/ally/enemy) and fight trims MoveSfx.level adds.

dredge.note: Grimble: the junk hoard on his back rattles and clinks (chests, tin, coins, a dull bell)

bulwark.note: Albert: barnacle armour clanks, plate on plate and shell crunch

rimewright.note: Neve: skate blades hiss on the ground

juggernaut.note: Kael: the chain at his collar and wrists

ashwick.note: Cinder: living-fire hair and molten seams crackle

thief.note: Sable: coat and buckle on steps, moth wings flutter on dashes

archer.note: Lace: porcelain joints click, the wooden control cross knocks

dolm.note: Tenzo: pebbles and the floating eye stones, a soft jade ring

gunslinger.note: Vex: brass ammo strap and the coin chain jingle

mage.note: Sparkle: copper coils at the wrists spit static

ostra.note: Motley: tiny jester bells and a flick of cards

tender.note: Meeko: the glass globe tinks, a raindrop drips

gil.note: Gil: potion vials clink in his bag, a wet slap of robe hem
